# optimizelycmp_field (Data Source)

Looks up one custom field by name. It fails if there is no match or more than one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmp_field" "priority" {
  name = "Priority"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Field name (case-insensitive exact match).

### Read-Only

- `helper_text` (String)
- `id` (String) ID of the custom field.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `type` (String)
